poses.prompt: Create one full-body pixel-art RPG character sprite, a NEW IDLE pose 00 for the supplied P1 hero facing UP-LEFT (northwest ↖), seen at a true three-quarter REAR view. Reference 1 is the original up-left orientation only; reference 2 is the approved new rear-view character design and full boot construction. Repaint the second design in the first view angle, but make the diagonal unmistakable: back of head and coat dominate, a little leftward face edge at most, torso and pelvis yaw 45 degrees toward upper-left, both toes point away toward upper-left, visible heel backs and outer side of boots; NOT straight rear, NOT front-left, NOT pure side. Character is short chibi chestnut spiky hair, vivid blue scarf trailing right, rich blue short coat with cream/gold hem and white cuffs, brown gloves, charcoal knee trousers, brown folded-cuff boots of matched volume, brown cross-body straps and small pouch. Match the approved pixel illustration style, outlines, character proportions, garment design, and calm neutral standing. Both feet planted, knees untwisted, full boot shafts connected to knees, natural small foot separation, no duck feet. Single entire character centered with generous transparent margin on all sides. No shadow, floor, glow, background, text, labels or panels. Transparent RGBA background.

Draw ONE complete pixel-art sprite of the SAME P1 character from reference 1 in a new WALKING pose. Reference 1 fixes character design, short chibi proportions, boot volume, and the exact UP-LEFT northwest three-quarter REAR camera angle. Reference 2 gives the gait PHASE viewed straight from rear; translate that phase into reference 1's diagonal camera, never copy the straight-rear orientation. Keep the head, shoulders, pelvis and both shoe toes consistently pointing AWAY toward upper-left ↖. Back of hair, scarf collar, coat back, crossing brown straps, right-side pouch, full folded-cuff brown boots, charcoal trousers, brown gloves, rich blue coat cream/gold trim remain exactly the same. Only a slim face edge, no visible eyes. View shows heels and outside of boots; sole visible ONLY on trailing heel roll, never backwards footwear. Compact ordinary walking, no running, lunging or gigantic rear sole. Keep both boot volumes and connected knee/ankle anatomy. Opposite arm swing and small weight transfer, restrained body bob. Preserve pixel illustration style, clear dark outline and coloring. Keep a consistent head size and same yaw as reference 1. No perspective zoom, no outfit redesign. Single whole figure centered with generous transparent margins. No background, cast shadow, glow, floor, text or panels. Transparent background. Near-side arm swings BACK toward viewer, far-side arm swings forward away; short stride, clearly separated feet.
